messages:
naomi: Heads up — a handful of active interviews just surfaced with scorecards where the custom weightings on the rubric have reverted to default after yesterday's WYSIWYG editor upgrade. Noticed during panel sync. Anyone else seeing this?
ryan: ugh, saw one candidate where 'leadership' weight dropped to 1/5, interviewer complains results are inconsistent.
maya: timeline: we released the editor change at 22:10 UTC yesterday. any migration hooks?
aj: the editor team said it was just a frontend change but there was a tiny server-side sanitize patch to strip unknown HTML attrs. maybe the weight metadata got dropped.
sasha: could be the attribute name collision we warned about — new sanitizer strips data-* attrs if not whitelisted. weights are stored as data-weight on question nodes.
janet: running a quick query to find affected scorecards now — sharing sample sql:```sql
SELECT id, template_name, updated_at FROM scorecard_templates WHERE updated_at >= '2024-05-24T22:00:00Z' AND data->>'weights' IS NULL LIMIT 50;
```
emma: we have 6 active interviews impacted this morning (recruiter side). We should avoid asking panels to re-score if we can backfill. Candidates are mid-loop.
naomi: prioritize non-disruptive fix: 1) identify templates where only weights were dropped, 2) backfill from backups or audit log, 3) pause any reminder emails.
ryan: I can pull the latest snapshot and diff the template blobs vs audit logs. If weights exist in prior version, we can PUT them back.
janet: found 42 templates with weights null; 27 of those have a pre-deploy audit entry with weights. I can produce a backfill CSV.
aj: deploy-bot — can we roll the sanitizer patch back or whitelist data-weight quickly?
deploy-bot: deploy 8d4f2cb rolled at 2024-05-24T22:10:12Z. Rollback requires a coord with infra, ETA ~30m if approved.
sasha: whitelist is safer than full rollback. I'll open a PR to add data-weight to the sanitizer config and add a small migration to restore missing attrs from audit trail.
maya: good — also need a comms plan for interviewers. naomi, can you draft a short note? we should avoid panic.
naomi: drafting now: "Quick note — you may see slight differences in scorecard display for active interviews. We're restoring rubric weightings automatically; no action needed unless we ping you." short and clear.
emma: thanks. also let's block sending scorecard reminders for affected templates until backfill completes. I can pause the reminder worker for those template ids.
ryan: I'm uploading a script to restore weights from audit logs:```bash
# usage: ./backfill_weights.sh <template-id>
curl -X GET https://internal-api/scorecards/<id>/audit | jq '.entries | map(select(.field=="weights")) | .[0].value' | xargs -I{} curl -X PATCH -d '{"weights": {}}' https://internal-api/scorecards/<id>
```
janet: running in dry-run mode now. so far looks clean.
sasha: PR open, tests added to prevent sanitizer regression. please prioritize code review.
deploy-bot: rollback approved by infra-team; automated rollback will start in 12 minutes if PR not merged.
naomi: plan: janet/rayan finish backfill verification (30m), aj/sasha accelerate whitelist PR (15m), emma pause reminders for the 42 templates (done), maya coordinate comms to interviewers (on it). will update here when backfill done.
ryan: backfill dry-run matched 42/42 — ready to apply. applying with rate limit to avoid flooding.
emma: reminders paused.
naomi: applied and verified two sample interviews — weights restored and scores unchanged on historical responses. rolling through remainder. will post final confirmation in ~20m. :thumbsup:
